source_evidence: Any promise to repay some or all of the money you invest will depend on the creditworthiness of the issuer of the note—meaning you could lose all of your money if the issuer of your note goes bankrupt.
question: Does a structured note labeled “principal protection” eliminate the risk of losing money?
answer: No. Any promise to repay some or all of your investment depends on the note issuer’s creditworthiness. If the issuer goes bankrupt, you could lose all of your money.
